interaction_thesis: Marking an invoice paid moves its amount across the ledger. The button leaves in 150ms, and the status pill stamps from Sent/Overdue to Paid on a spring (stiffness 520, damping 30). Outstanding counts down while Paid counts up by exactly that amount over 700ms on `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`, with Paid starting 120ms after Outstanding. Each card shows a signed amount (−€ / +€) for 1.6s, and an aria-live line says what landed.
allowed_patterns: counting numbers on the two totals; a temporary signed amount on the summary cards.
assumptions: the mood is calm bookkeeping, not celebration; "landed" means the amount moving between the two totals; reduced motion and screen readers are covered.
variant_picked: B, "Ledger", from three (A Settle, C Transfer)

skill_bug_reported_by_run: the module loader in the skill text arrived with its $1/$2 placeholders replaced by the second shell-quoted argument of the invocation ("Mark as paid"), so as written it could not find any module; the run rebuilt it with the placeholders restored. Cause: Claude Code substitutes $N in a skill's text with the invocation's arguments; skills/cast, paint and bunshin SKILL.md all use $1/$2 in their shell functions. Fixed on branch fix/skill-arguments, to ship as 4.1.1.
